items.name: Afrikaans

sample.text: Alle menslike wesens word vry, met gelyke waardigheid en regte, gebore. Hulle het rede en gewete en behoort in die gees van broederskap teenoor mekaar op te tree.

tells: Dutch-looking but simpler: "die", "is", "en", "van"
Double negative "nie ... nie" at sentence ends
ê, ë, ô and the word "'n" (a/an)
items.blurb: Afrikaans is a West Germanic language spoken in South Africa, Namibia, and to a lesser extent Botswana, Zambia, Zimbabwe, and also in Argentina, where a group in Sarmiento speaks a Patagonian dialect, and among the South African diaspora.

items.name: Albanian

sample.text: Të gjithë njerëzit lindin të lirë dhe të barabartë në dinjitet dhe në të drejta. Ata kanë arsye dhe ndërgjegje dhe duhet të sillen ndaj njëri tjetrit me frymë vëllazërimi.

tells: ë everywhere (e with two dots)
ç and digraphs xh, sh, gj, nj, dh
Words "dhe", "të", "në", "për"
items.blurb: Albanian is an Indo-European language and the only surviving representative of the Albanic branch, which belongs to the Paleo-Balkan group. It is the native language of the Albanian people.

items.name: Amharic

sample.text: የሰው፡ልጅ፡ሁሉ፡ሲወለድ፡ነጻና፡በክብርና፡በመብትም፡እኩልነት፡ያለው፡ነው።፡የተፈጥሮ፡ማስተዋልና፡ሕሊና፡ስላለው፡አንዱ፡ሌላውን፡በወንድማማችነት፡መንፈስ፡መመልከት፡ይገባዋል።

tells: Ge'ez (Ethiopic) script: each letter is a whole syllable
Letters like ሀ, ለ, መ, ሰ with little feet and tails
Word separator ፡ and full stop ።
items.blurb: Amharic is an Ethio-Semitic language, which is a subgrouping within the Semitic branch of the Afroasiatic languages. It is spoken as a first language by the Habesha Amhara people, and also serves as a lingua franca for all other metropolitan populations in Ethiopia.

items.name: Arabic

sample.text: يولد جميع الناس أحرارًا متساوين في الكرامة والحقوق. وقد وهبوا عقلاً وضميرًا وعليهم أن يعامل بعضهم بعضًا بروح الإخاء.

tells: Right-to-left, flowing joined letters
The article "ال" (al-) at the start of many words
ة (taa marbuta) at word ends; no پ, چ, ژ, گ
facts: Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman +17 more
items.blurb: Arabic is a Central Semitic language of the Afroasiatic language family spoken primarily in the Arab world.

items.name: Armenian

sample.text: Բոլոր մարդիկ ծնվում են ազատ ու հավասար իրենց արժանապատվությամբ ու իրավունքներով։ Նրանք ունեն բանականություն ու խիղճ և միմյանց պետք է եղբայրաբար վերաբերվեն։

tells: Its own alphabet with many hooked letters: ո, ւ, ն, մ
Frequent "ու" pairs
Looks a bit like rounded Latin letters with tails
items.blurb: Armenian is the sole member of an independent branch in the Indo-European language family. It is the native language of the Armenian people and the official language of Armenia.

items.name: Aymara

sample.text: Taqpach jaqejh khuskat uñjatatäpjhewa munañapansa, lurañapansa, amuyasiñapansa, ukatwa jilani sullkanípjhaspas ukham uñjasipjhañapawa.

tells: Three vowels a, i, u and ä, ï, ü for long ones
Ejective apostrophes: k', q', t'
Endings -naka, -taki, -wa
items.blurb: Aymara is an Aymaran language spoken by the Aymara people of the Bolivian Andes. It is one of only a handful of Amerindian languages with over one million speakers.

items.name: Azerbaijani

sample.text: Bütün insanlar ləyaqət və hüquqlarına görə azad və bərabər doğulurlar. Onların şüurları və vicdanları var və bir-birlərinə münasibətdə qardaşlıq ruhunda davranmalıdırlar.

tells: ə (schwa) — the giveaway letter
Turkish-like ğ, ı, ş, ç, ö, ü
Also q and x, which Turkish doesn't use
items.blurb: Azerbaijani or Azeri is a Turkic language from the Oghuz sub-branch. It is spoken primarily by the Azerbaijani people, who are native to the Azerbaijan region of Iran, as well as the Republic of Azerbaijan.

items.name: Belarusian

sample.text: Усе людзі нараджаюцца свабоднымі і роўнымі ў сваёй годнасці і правах. Яны надзелены розумам і сумленнем і павінны ставіцца адзін да аднаго ў духу брацтва.

tells: ў (short u) — a letter only Belarusian uses
і instead of и; still has ы and э
Many "а" where Russian writes "о" (akanne)
items.blurb: Belarusian is an East Slavic language. It is one of the two official languages in Belarus, the other being Russian.

items.name: Bengali

sample.text: সমস্ত মানুষ স্বাধীনভাবে সমান মর্যাদা এবং অধিকার নিয়ে জন্মগ্রহণ করে। তাঁদের বিবেক এবং বুদ্ধি আছে; সুতরাং সকলেরই একে অপরের প্রতি ভ্রাতৃত্বসুলভ মনোভাব নিয়ে আচরণ করা উচিত।

tells: A headline bar like Devanagari, but letters with triangular tops (ব, ক, স)
Letters hang below the line more
Sentence-end mark ।
facts: Also one of India's scheduled languages (West Bengal).
items.blurb: Bengali, also known by its endonym Bangla, is an Indo-Aryan language belonging to the Indo-Iranian branch of the Indo-European language family.

items.name: Berber (Tamazight)

sample.text: ⴰⵔ ⴷ ⵜⵜⵍⴰⵍⴰⵏ ⵎⵉⴷⴷⵏ ⴳⴰⵏ ⵉⵍⴻⵍⵍⵉⵜⵏ ⵎⴳⴰⴷⴷⴰⵏ ⵖ ⵡⴰⴷⴷⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵣⵔⴼⴰⵏ, ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⴰⴽⵯ ⴷⴰⵔⵙⵏ ⵓⵏⵍⵍⵉ ⴷ ⵓⴼⵔⴰⴽ, ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⴼⵍⵍⴰ ⵙⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵜⵎⵢⴰⵡⴰⵙⵏ ⵏⴳⵔⴰⵜⵙⵏ ⵙ ⵜⴰⴳⵎⴰⵜ.

tells: Tifinagh letters made of circles, lines and dots: ⵜ, ⴰ, ⵎ, ⵣ
The symbol ⵣ (yaz) appears on the Amazigh flag
Also often written in Latin script with ɣ, ɛ, ḍ
items.blurb: Standard Moroccan Amazigh, also known as Standard Moroccan Tamazight or Standard Moroccan Berber, is a standardized language developed by the Royal Institute of Amazigh Culture in Morocco by combining features of Tashelhit, Central Atlas Tamazight, and Tarifit, the three major Amazigh languages in Morocco.

items.name: Bislama

sample.text: Evri man mo woman i bon fri mo ikwol long respek mo ol raet. Oli gat risen mo tingting mo oli mas tritim wanwan long olgeta olsem ol brata mo sista.

tells: English words respelled: "evri", "man", "blong", "mo"
"blong" (belong) for "of"
Plural "ol" before nouns
items.blurb: Bislama, also known by its earlier French name, bichelamar, is an English-based creole language that is the national language of Vanuatu, and one of the three official languages of the country, the other two being English and French.

items.name: Bosnian
tells: Latin with đ, ć, č, š, ž like Croatian
"ije" spellings and Turkish/Arabic loanwords (e.g. with "h": kahva)
Practically mutually intelligible with Croatian and Serbian
facts: Practically identical to Croatian on paper
items.blurb: Bosnian is the standard variety of the Serbo-Croatian language mainly used by Bosniaks.

items.name: Bulgarian

sample.text: Всички хора се раждат свободни и равни по достойнство и права. Те са надарени с разум и съвест и следва да се отнасят помежду си в дух на братство.

tells: ъ used as a vowel in the middle of words
щ is common; no ы or э
Definite endings -ът, -та, -то
items.blurb: Bulgarian is an Eastern South Slavic language spoken in Southeast Europe, primarily in Bulgaria. It is the language of the Bulgarians.

items.name: Burmese

sample.text: လူတိုင်းသည် တူညီ လွတ်လပ်သော ဂုဏ်သိက္ခာဖြင့် လည်းကောင်း၊ တူညီလွတ်လပ်သော အခွင့်အရေးများဖြင့် လည်းကောင်း၊ မွေးဖွားလာသူများ ဖြစ်သည်။ ထိုသူတို့၌ ပိုင်းခြား ဝေဖန်တတ်သော ဉာဏ်နှင့် ကျင့်ဝတ် သိတတ်သော စိတ်တို့ရှိကြ၍ ထိုသူတို့သည် အချင်းချင်း မေတ္တာထား၍…

tells: Letters built from circles: ဗ, ဝ, ပ, မ
Almost no straight lines
Sentences end with ။
items.blurb: Burmese is a Tibeto-Burman language spoken in Myanmar, where it is the official language, lingua franca, and the native language of the Bamar, the country's largest ethnic group.

items.name: Catalan

sample.text: Tots els éssers humans neixen lliures i iguals en dignitat i en drets. Són dotats de raó i de consciència, i han de comportar-se fraternalment els uns amb els altres.

tells: The "punt volat" l·l (as in "col·lectiu")
Words ending in -ció and -itat; "els", "amb", "dels"
Grave accents à, è, ò alongside ç
facts: Also co-official in Catalonia, Valencia and the Balearic Islands (Spain).
items.blurb: Catalan is a Western Romance language that is native to the eastern Iberian Peninsula.

items.name: Chichewa

sample.text: Anthu onse amabadwa aufulu ndiponso ofanana mu ulemu ndi ufulu wao. Iwowa ndi wodalitsidwa ndi mphamvu zoganiza ndi chikumbumtima ndipo achitirane wina ndi mnzake mwaubale.

tells: Prefixes chi-, ku-, a-, mu-
Frequent "ndi", "kuti", "ali"
Words ending in vowels, no clicks
items.blurb: Chewa is a Bantu language spoken in Malawi and a recognised minority in Eastern Zambia and Tete province of Mozambique. The prefix chi- in front of Chewa means "in the manner of".

items.name: Comorian

sample.text: Wo wanadamu piya wo uzalwa na uhuriya na usawa waki undru na uhaki. Wo upwawa ankili na urambuzi hayizo yilazimu warwaliyane hazitrendwa na fikira zaki unanya.

tells: Swahili-like words with "sh" and "dj"
Prefixes shi-, wa-, ma-
Frequent "na", "ya", "ha"
items.blurb: Comorian is a group of four Bantu languages spoken in the Comoros Islands, an archipelago in the southwestern Indian Ocean between Mozambique and Madagascar. It is one of the official languages of the Union of the Comoros in the Comorian constitution.

items.name: Croatian

sample.text: Sva ljudska bića rađaju se slobodna i jednaka u dostojanstvu i pravima. Ona su obdarena razumom i sviješću i treba da jedno prema drugome postupaju u duhu bratstva.

tells: đ, ć and č together with š, ž
"ije" spellings (dijete, lijepo)
Croatian month names and words like "tisuća", "kruh"
items.blurb: Croatian is the standard variety of the Serbo-Croatian language mainly used by Croats.

items.name: Czech

sample.text: Všichni lidé rodí se svobodní a sobě rovní co do důstojnosti a práv. Jsou nadáni rozumem a svědomím a mají spolu jednat v duchu bratrství.

tells: ř — a letter only Czech has
ů (u with a ring) and háčeks: č, š, ž, ě
Long vowels with acutes: á, é, í, ý
items.blurb: Czech, historically known as Bohemian, is a West Slavic language of the Czech–Slovak group, written in Latin script. Spoken by over 12 million people including second-language speakers, it serves as the official language of the Czech Republic.

items.name: Danish

sample.text: Alle mennesker er født frie og lige i værdighed og rettigheder. De er udstyret med fornuft og samvittighed, og de bør handle mod hverandre i en broderskabets ånd.

tells: æ, ø and å
Soft consonants: words like "med", "ved", "skal", "af"
Very close to Norwegian, but with "-ed", "-eg" spellings (meget, jeg)
items.blurb: Danish is a North Germanic language from the Indo-European language family spoken by about 5.5 million people, principally in and around Denmark.

items.name: Dari
tells: The Afghan variety of Persian — same Perso-Arabic letters (پ, چ, ژ, گ)
Very hard to tell from Iranian Persian in writing
Co-official with Pashto
facts: Practically identical to Persian on paper
items.blurb: Dari, also known as Farsi Dari, Dari Persian, Eastern Persian, or Afghan Persian, is the variety of the Persian language spoken in Afghanistan.

items.name: Dhivehi

sample.text: ހުރިހާ އިންސާނުންވެސް ދުނިޔެއަށް އުފަންވަނީ، މިނިވަންކަމުގައި، ހަމަހަމަ ޙައްޤުތަކަކާއެކު، ހަމަހަމަ ދަރަޖައެއްގައި ކަމޭހިތެވިގެންވާ ބައެއްގެ ގޮތުގައެވެ. ހެޔޮ ވިސްނުމާއި، ހެޔޮބުއްދީގެ ބާރު އެމީހުންނަށް ލިބިގެންވެއެވެ.

tells: Thaana script: right-to-left, short hook-like letters
Vowel marks above and below every letter
Looks a bit like Arabic, but the letters don't join
items.blurb: Maldivian, also known by its endonym Divehi, is an Indo-Aryan language belonging to the Indo-Iranian branch of the Indo-European language family, primarily spoken by the Maldivian people native to the South Asian archipelagic state of the Maldives; as well as the neighbouring Minicoy Island within Lakshadweep, a union territory of India.

items.name: Dutch

sample.text: Alle mensen worden vrij en gelijk in waardigheid en rechten geboren. Zij zijn begiftigd met verstand en geweten, en behoren zich jegens elkander in een geest van broederschap te gedragen.

tells: The digraph "ij" everywhere (zijn, mij)
Double vowels: aa, ee, oo, uu
Words "het", "een", "en", "van"; diminutive -tje / -je
items.blurb: Dutch is a West Germanic language of the Indo-European language family, spoken by about 25 million people as a first language and 5 million as a second language and is the third most spoken Germanic language.

items.name: Dzongkha

sample.text: འགྲོ་བ་མི་ཚུ་ག་ར་དལ་དབང་གི་ཐོག་ལས་སྐྱེས་ཏེ་ཡོདཔ་ལས་ ག་ར་ལུ་བརྩི་མཐོང་དང་ཐོབ་དབང་འདྲ་མཉམ་སྦེ་ཡོད། མི་ཚུ་ག་ར་སྨྲ་ཤེས་དོན་གོ་བའི་མཚན་ཉིད་དང་ལྡནམ་ལས་ ག་ར་གིས་ལཱ་ག་ཅི་ར་འབད་རུང་ གཅིག་གིས་གཅིག་ལུ་སྤུན་ཆའི་འདུ་ཤེས་བསྐྱེད་ཐོག་ལས་ལཱ་འབད་དགོ།

tells: Tibetan script: letters hanging from a top line
A dot ་ (tsek) between every syllable
Stacked consonants
items.blurb: Dzongkha, also known by its exonym Bhutanese, is a Tibetic language spoken primarily by the Bhutanese people. It is the official and national language of Bhutan, and is written using the Tibetan script in formal contexts, with informal correspondence in the Joyig script.

items.name: English

sample.text: All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights. They are endowed with reason and conscience and should act towards one another in a spirit of brotherhood.

tells: No accents at all on the letters
Very common short words: "the", "and", "of", "is"
Lots of "th" and "-ing"
facts: United Kingdom, Ireland, United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand +52 more
De facto rather than legally official in some countries (e.g. the US, UK and Australia).
items.blurb: English is a West Germanic language of the Indo-European language family that emerged in early medieval England and has since become a global lingua franca. The language is named after the Angles, one of the Germanic peoples who migrated to Britain after the end of Roman rule.

items.name: Estonian

sample.text: Kõik inimesed sünnivad vabadena ja võrdsetena oma väärikuselt ja õigustelt. Neile on antud mõistus ja südametunnistus ja nende suhtumist üksteisesse peab kandma vendluse vaim.

tells: õ (o with tilde) — almost unique to Estonian
ä, ö, ü and double vowels like Finnish
Words ending -mine, -ga, -st
items.blurb: Estonian is a Finnic language of the Uralic language family, and is the official language of Estonia. Estonian is written using the Latin alphabet and is the first language of the majority of the country's population; it is also an official language of the European Union.

items.name: Fijian

sample.text: Era sucu ena galala na tamata yadua, era tautauvata ena nodra dokai kei na nodra dodonu. E tiko na nodra vakasama kei na nodra lewaeloma, sa dodonu mera veidokadokai ena yalo ni veitacini.

tells: c (sounds like "th"), q and "dr"
Words starting "vaka-"
Frequent "na", "ni", "e", "kei"
items.blurb: Fijian is an Austronesian language of the Malayo-Polynesian family spoken by some 350,000–450,000 ethnic Fijians as a native language. In the 2013 constitution, Fijian is a national language of Fiji, along with English and Fiji Hindi.

items.name: Filipino

sample.text: Ang lahat ng tao'y isinilang na malaya at pantay-pantay sa karangalan at mga karapatan. Sila'y pinagkalooban ng katwiran at budhi at dapat magpalagayan ang isa't isa sa diwa ng pagkakapatiran.

tells: The little words "ang", "ng", "mga", "sa"
Lots of "ng" and repeated syllables
Spanish loanwords spelled phonetically
items.blurb: Filipino is the national language, the main lingua franca, and one of the two official languages of the Philippines alongside English. It is a de facto standardized form of the Tagalog language, as spoken and written in Metro Manila and in other urban centers of the archipelago.

items.name: Finnish

sample.text: Kaikki ihmiset syntyvät vapaina ja tasavertaisina arvoltaan ja oikeuksiltaan. Heille on annettu järki ja omatunto, ja heidän on toimittava toisiaan kohtaan veljeyden hengessä.

tells: Lots of double letters: "aa", "ii", "kk", "tt"
ä and ö but no å in native words
Long words with case endings -ssa, -sta, -lla, -ksi
items.blurb: Finnish is a Finnic language of the Uralic language family, spoken by the majority of the population in Finland and by ethnic Finns outside of Finland. Finnish is one of the two official languages of Finland, alongside Swedish.

items.name: French

sample.text: Tous les êtres humains naissent libres et égaux en dignité et en droits. Ils sont doués de raison et de conscience et doivent agir les uns envers les autres dans un esprit de fraternité.

tells: Accents é, è, ê, à, ç and the ligature œ
Apostrophes glued to words: l', d', qu'
Common words "les", "des", "et", "est", "qui"
facts: France, Belgium, Switzerland, Luxembourg, Monaco, Canada +23 more
items.blurb: French is a Romance language of the Indo-European family. Like all other Romance languages, French and its closest relatives—the langues d'oïl, historically spoken in northern France and southern Belgium—descended from the Vulgar Latin of the Roman Empire.

items.name: Georgian

sample.text: ყოველი ადამიანი იბადება თავისუფალი და თანასწორი თავისი ღირსებითა და უფლებებით. მათ მინიჭებული აქვთ გონება და სინდისი და ერთმანეთის მიმართ უნდა ექცეოდნენ ძმობის სულისკვეთებით.

tells: Its own rounded, curly alphabet (Mkhedruli)
No capital letters
Letters like ა, ბ, გ, დ that look like loops and hooks
items.blurb: Georgian is the most widely spoken Kartvelian language. It is the official language of Georgia and the native or primary language of 88% of its population.

items.name: German

sample.text: Alle Menschen sind frei und gleich an Würde und Rechten geboren. Sie sind mit Vernunft und Gewissen begabt und sollen einander im Geist der Brüderlichkeit begegnen.

tells: Every noun starts with a capital letter
ß and umlauts ä, ö, ü
Long compound words; "sch", "-ung", "und", "der/die/das"
facts: Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, Belgium
items.blurb: German is a West Germanic language in the Indo-European language family, mainly spoken in Western and Central Europe. It is the majority and official language in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, and Liechtenstein.

items.name: Greek

sample.text: Όλοι οι άνθρωποι γεννιούνται ελεύθεροι και ίσοι στην αξιοπρέπεια και τα δικαιώματα. Είναι προικισμένοι με λογική και συνείδηση, και οφείλουν να συμπεριφέρονται μεταξύ τους με πνεύμα αδελφοσύνης.

tells: Greek alphabet: α β γ δ λ π σ/ς ω
Accent marks on vowels (ά, ή, ώ)
Final sigma ς at word ends
items.blurb: Greek is an Indo-European language, constituting an independent Hellenic branch within the Indo-European language family.

items.name: Guarani
